local_loss_method: Exact section polygons -> inward0.4mm/outward0.4mm morphological opening, round joins24. Local losses are reported even when whole components survive. Not extrusion path simulation.
limitations: Corner rounding produces nonzero local loss; no claim of perfect detail survival.
Grid beams, upper slabs and diagonal starts require support or alternative orientation.
No FFF toolpaths or physical print tested.
